verdict.rationale: Quo documents an explicit date-based API versioning policy. A required Quo-Api-Version header pins each request to a frozen version, breaking changes are enumerated, and retirement is promised only after a changelog announcement with a migration window. The legacy v1 API remains supported under the same notice terms, and dated OpenAPI documents back the versioned surface. Missing for 10: a stated minimum length for the deprecation/migration window, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the policy has been honored in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Every version is a date. Every request declares which date it was built for
A version is frozen the day it ships.
No version disappears quietly. If a version is ever scheduled for retirement, we'll announce it in the changelog with a migration window and a precise list of what changed.
